correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact first residual minimization: symmetric commuting A,E imply B=I+A(E+omega I) SPD, eigenvalues 1+a(omega+e)>0; sharp Kantorovich two-extreme residual factor equals (v-u)/(v+u), attained by residual squared weights v/(u+v),u/(u+v). In dimension two attained A eigenvalues force a=mu,L, so max interval-endpoint ratio gives the two terms in K2. With n≥3 two independent L-eigenvectors support opposite extreme errors for omega≤delta, producing a new worst-case branch K3=(1+L(omega+delta))/(1+L(omega-delta)); for omega≥delta the minimum moves to mu, giving the second branch. Derivatives determine delta_c=(L-mu)/(2mu L), 2D switch omega2=(sqrt(1+(mu+L)²delta²)-1)/(mu+L), and n≥3 switch at omega=delta. Flat critical rays and no finite minimizer above critical follow directly. Independent exact rational endpoint perturbation enumerations and GMRES eigenweight witnesses were reproduced for multiple mu,L,delta,omega. Checks do not cover noncommuting errors, iterative flexible GMRES, or measured hardware.
